summary.zh: 让关键设施覆盖更多需求，同时减少无效重叠。
summary.en: Reach more demand with facilities while reducing wasted overlap.

rules.zh: 玩家查看设施作用范围，把需要服务的对象安排在有效区域。边界、路径和容量限制收益；覆盖提示与未服务对象引导下一轮选址。
rules.en: Players place facilities and users within effective reach. Boundaries, access and capacity constrain benefits; overlays and unserved users guide new sites.

decisions.zh: 中心位置覆盖广，却占据宝贵地块。
decisions.en: Central sites cover broadly but use valuable land.

decisions.zh: 边缘站点减少盲区，却增加重复建设。
decisions.en: Peripheral sites fill gaps at the cost of duplication.

effect.zh: 圆形易理解，沿路传播强调路网配合。
effect.en: A radius is readable; road-based reach rewards network planning.

effect.zh: 容量有限时，已覆盖区域也可能需要新设施。
effect.en: Limited capacity can require more facilities within covered areas.

contrast.zh: 工作台提供局部建造支持；城市服务还要应对通行与容量限制。
contrast.en: Workbenches provide local construction support; city services add access and capacity limits.

combination.zh: 设计每天只驻扎一个位置的流动兽医营地，覆盖不同农场并处理有限诊疗量。
combination.en: Design a mobile vet camp choosing one daily site with limited treatment capacity.

setup.zh: 四间房需要服务，一个设施放中心能覆盖三间，放边缘只能覆盖两间。
setup.en: Four houses need a service; a central facility reaches three while an edge location reaches two.

action.zh: 你先放中心，再用剩余预算考虑最远那间房。
action.en: Place the central facility first, then consider the farthest house with the remaining budget.

result.zh: 覆盖预览与未服务标记显示选址效果，重叠区没有自动多一份收益。
result.en: Coverage and unserved markers show the outcome; overlapping coverage need not add value.

next.zh: 住宅扩展后重新看缺口，再决定新增或迁移设施。
next.en: Review new gaps after housing expansion before adding or relocating facilities.

firstStep.zh: 做有限地图、几个需求点和一个可移动覆盖圆，显示覆盖数量与建造成本。
firstStep.en: Use a bounded map, demand points and a movable coverage circle, showing coverage count and cost.

pitfall.zh: 覆盖范围、服务容量和道路可达是三种限制，首版先清楚区分再逐项加入。
pitfall.en: Range, capacity and route access are different limits; distinguish them clearly and add them one at a time.

test.zh: 在新增需求点后，玩家是否会重新评估旧设施位置，而不只是继续堆数量？
test.en: After new demand appears, do players reassess existing locations instead of simply adding more facilities?
